description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Gnarlback Elm.
When Gnarlback Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Gnarlback Elm enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
